card.name: Linking words before reflux and ulcer terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, to, as, and) right before a stomach-acid condition such as GERD, erosive esophagitis, reflux laryngitis or duodenal ulcer. Mostly in acid-reducer dosing tables and reflux explanations.

modes.label: Treatment of ...
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'Treatment' in an indication row, just before a reflux or ulcer condition.

modes.label: due to / referred to as
modes.description: 'to' or 'as' in phrases that lead into a named reflux condition.
modes.example: the condition is referred to<< as>> reflux laryngitis.
